scientific_integrity: Complete analytic chain-decomposition proof for all real parameters, with finite checker used solely as independent diagnostics; exact-source first public date from arXiv v1.
scientific_limitations: Sharp only for equal uniform marginals on an interval and one prescribed exact absolute separation; uniqueness of optimizers and multi-distance generalizations not established. General transport duality applies variationally; historical priority of the closed-form specialization is limited to inspected works. No independent mathematical validation.
title: Sharp parity cusps for exact-distance copula capacity
